transport_design: trade_copier/mutation_transport.py: resolve_governed_follower_route route-pins to the ENABLED governed follower + resolves its OWN per-tenant endpoint via snapshot_transport.resolve_account_snapshot_base (fails closed; never global/sibling); _identity_matches binds command expected_login/server to the resolved account_number/server; _agent_token from the env chain (never repo/args/logs); send_mutation enforces the deadline, POSTs MODIFY/CLOSE to the op route, ONE shot never retried, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME on timeout/error/indeterminate non-2xx (never success). Default OFF (copier_mutation_transport_enabled) -> INERT, no broker contact. PARTIAL keeps its worker; OPEN the PLACE_ORDER path.
red_admission_design: scripts/mt5_signal_bridge.py: _copier_live_mutation_admitted / _demo_or_admitted_ok narrow the account_not_demo wall for the ONE governed route only. Admits a LIVE mutation ONLY when: COPIER_LIVE_MUTATION_ADMIT_ENABLED on AND the lifecycle guard is active (binds the ACTUAL position symbol/pre-state/deadline) AND the full live stack (_bridge_live_admitted = MT5_ALLOW_LIVE + non-expired MT5_LIVE_EXPIRY) AND a typed command for the same op AND exact-account TRIPLE agreement (runtime MT5_EXPECTED_LOGIN == connected account == command expected_login; server fail-closed) AND command.symbol == COPIER_LIVE_ADMIT_SYMBOL. Fail-closed on any miss/error; read fresh per call (restart/expiry/drift fail closed). Applied at BOTH the top-of-function wall AND the send-time identity gate (evaluate_mutation_identity) so the two walls are consistent. Default OFF / no command -> exactly trade_mode==0 (byte-identical). Authorises no other account/route/symbol/op; no single flag enables trading.
no_late_recovery_proof: The transport/dispatcher send only an EXISTING MODIFY/CLOSE on a bound follower ticket; they open no position and never recover a late/failed OPEN. A timeout/indeterminate result is UNKNOWN (need_reconcile, job RUNNING), never retried, never success. A past-deadline/expired command is blocked pre-send (nothing sent -> FAILED). The guard (required for a live mutation) rejects a past-deadline/stale-revision/pre-state-mismatch command.

adversarial_review.method: One independent adversarial subagent lane on the full live-money path (dispatcher -> transport -> bridge money functions + both demo walls + producer gate stack). Attack checklist: cross-tenant mutation, account/server/login substitution, symbol substitution, admission bypass, replay/duplicate/late execution, MODIFY-after-CLOSE/wrong-ticket, dispatcher state machine, secret leakage, fail-open.
adversarial_review.result: No CRITICAL. 1 HIGH + 2 MEDIUM + 2 LOW, ALL FIXED with regression tests. Verified sound: cross-tenant routing (fails closed, no global/sibling, no caller URL), login triple-agreement airtight, OFF-path byte-identity, replay/double-execute prevented (single-flight + at-most-once + UNKNOWN-not-re-picked), guard_blocked->CONTAINED mapping never mis-maps a real send, no secret leakage.

findings.title: The send-time identity gate (evaluate_mutation_identity) kept a SECOND account_not_demo wall, silently defeating the new top-wall admission (feature non-functional / latent trap); no test exercised the real money path with a LIVE account.
findings.fix: evaluate_mutation_identity / verify_mutation_identity now thread (command, op) and consult the SAME _demo_or_admitted_ok as the top wall, so the two walls are consistent (and byte-identical when OFF/no-command). Regressions: test_send_time_identity_gate_consistent_with_top_wall, test_send_time_gate_demo_always_ok_no_command.

findings.title: The dispatcher's send-time authority re-check omitted the per-op LIVE arm flags + copier_live_execute_enabled (gate-parity gap vs the producer): a job minted while a per-op arm was ON could still dispatch after a SELECTIVE per-op disarm.
findings.fix: _governing_authority_ok now re-checks copier_live_execute_enabled() AND live_execution._per_op_flag_armed(op) at send time, before the authz relock.

findings.title: The admission was not coupled to the lifecycle guard; its symbol pin bound the command's DECLARED symbol, not the actual ticket's position symbol; the per-command deadline was not enforced by the bridge admission.
findings.fix: _copier_live_mutation_admitted now REQUIRES _copier_guard_active(command): the guard (mandatory for a live mutation) binds the actual position symbol, pre-state, revision and per-command deadline. Regression: test_guard_required_for_admission.

findings.title: Admission server pin could skip verification when both MT5_EXPECTED_SERVER and the connected server were blank (weaker server leg).
findings.fix: Server pin is now fail-closed: the connected AND command servers must both be present and agree, and a configured runtime server must agree too. Regression: test_blank_server_leg_fails_closed.

findings.title: follower_mutation_hwm failed OPEN to -1 on a DB read error, disabling the stale-revision check for that command.
findings.fix: follower_mutation_hwm returns None on error; _build_command returns None; dispatch_one refuses the dispatch (watermark_unavailable, nothing sent).
